thread:
incident-bot: [SEV2] High p99 latency observed on /v1/streaming/generate - multiple customers reporting stalls and timeouts :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Affected service: inference-controlplane (auth/config fetch path). Paging oncall team: @oncall_sre_ashley.
oncall_sre_ashley: Got the page, looking now. Anyone seen error spikes in auth or config?
noah_prod: Seeing p95 -> 420ms, p99 -> 3.6s for streaming endpoints since ~10:42 UTC. Dashboard shows a sharp increase in upstream 5xx from configstore reads.
maria_infra: Logs show configstore read latency climbing. I'm pulling traces.
james_backend: From app logs: several requests returned 504 after waiting for config fetch. Sample trace id: `trace-0a1b2c3d`.
rohit_db: DB read queue depth is high on primary config shard `cfg-7`. Seen elevated `pg_stat_activity` wait_event = IO and autovacuum spikes.
oncall_sre_ashley: Initial hypothesis: config fetch path is stalling requests to inference proxy causing streaming stalls. We should route to fallback cached config if possible.
kate_support: Customer-impact: 3 enterprise customers reported degraded streaming (timeouts, partial responses). Support is aware.
noah_prod: Reproduced locally with curl: `curl -v -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streaming/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"` - the connection hangs waiting for model tokens.
maria_infra: Trace snippet:
```
configstore.fetch(key=user:acct:12345) -> 1.8s
featureflag.resolve -> 0.4s
auth.check -> 0.1s
inference.proxy.send -> blocked waiting for configstore
```
rohit_db: DB stats: `max_connections=500`, `active=480`, `waiting=120`, `avg_io_wait=210ms`. I can promote read-replica to handle config reads for non-critical flags.
james_backend: We have fallback cache disabled for rolling flag merges. I can flip configfetch fallback on via runtime flag `config.fetch.fallback_enabled=true` if SRE agrees. That will use local cache for 95% of requests.
oncall_sre_ashley: Do it. Toggle it and monitor. Also add short-circuit to avoid waiting on DB for more than 500ms.
maria_infra: Patch applied to edge config service: `config.fetch.timeout=500ms` and `config.fetch.fallback=true`. Pushing now.
incident-bot: Deploy started by maria_infra (deploy-3567). Canarying to 10% of traffic.
noah_prod: After canary, p95 back down to ~180ms in canary region. p99 still elevated overall.
rohit_db: Offloading reads to replica `cfg-r2` for non-critical reads. Applied read-only connection pool change on config service.
james_backend: Adding a circuit-breaker in proxy to return last-known config for streaming clients while providing a background refresh. Patch posted in PR #5421.
oncall_sre_ashley: Good. Next: are we seeing any auth rate-limit errors that could be contributing?
noah_prod: There are bursts of token-validate RPC retries from inference instances around the same window, likely due to timeouts on config -> retrying auth calls.
maria_infra: I increased retry backoff in auth client so it doesn't flood DB. Also disabled aggressive client-side retries for 2 minutes via runtime flag.
rohit_db: After reducing retries and offloading reads, DB queue depth dropped 30%. IO wait now ~90ms.
noah_prod: p95 steady at 160ms, p99 improved to ~900ms. Streaming stall reports decreased but still one enterprise customer seeing partial stream cuts.
oncall_sre_ashley: Escalate to a handoff for the next shift. I'll compile timeline and mitigations.
noah_prod: Taking note: timeline for handoff:
- 10:42 UTC: initial p99 spike and customer reports
- 10:44 UTC: incident-bot page
- 10:47 UTC: toggle fallback cache and fetch timeout
- 10:49 UTC: offload reads to replica
- 10:55 UTC: reduced retries/backoff change
- 11:02 UTC: visible p99 improvement but one customer still affected
kate_support: Customer A reported partial stream resumed after ~30s delay once fallback applied. Customer B still seeing truncation. Support has collected request ids and will provide to oncall.
james_backend: Investigating truncation case - looks like proxy dropped connection when config TTL refreshed mid-stream. I'll patch to avoid mid-stream config rebinds.
oncall_sre_ashley: Short-term mitigations summary: fallback cache enabled, config fetch timeout reduced, read replica onlined, retry backoff reduced, canary deploy in place. Next steps: patch proxy to prevent mid-stream config swaps and add guard to keep active stream pinned to initial config until completion or a safe checkpoint.
maria_infra: I'll keep canary for 30m and then roll. If p99 stays <1s we can close.
rohit_db: I'll run a short checkpoint: reindex on cfg-7 scheduled in 2h when traffic is lower.
incident-bot: Incident update: Severity downgraded to SEV3 — customer impact reduced but investigation continues.
oncall_sre_ashley: Handoff to next oncall @sre-handoff-bot at 11:10 UTC. Please review timeline and follow next steps.
sre-handoff-bot: Handoff acknowledged. Handoff notes: fallback cache roll applied, replica `cfg-r2` handling reads, PR #5421 for circuit-breaker in review, patch to prevent mid-stream config swap in progress. Paging next owner for DB maintenance: @rohit_db.
rohit_db: Acknowledged, will watch for anomalies. I'll confirm reindex schedule and retention of replica promotion if needed.
noah_prod: I'll keep monitoring metrics and validate customer traces from support. Pushing alert tweak to lower noise: increase p99 alert window to 5m for this signal while we stabilize.
oncall_sre_ashley: Thanks team. If any regression re-escalate immediately. Closing thread for now, will update if any regression or if customer B remains affected after further fixes.
